newsitem.title: FRANCE: 37 bombs rock Corsica, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: 37 bombs rock Corsica, no casualties.

text.p: Thirty-seven bombs rocked the French Mediterranean island of Corsica on Sunday in an show of force by separatist guerrillas, police said.

No one was hurt and no one claimed immediate responsibility for the blasts at banks, tax offices and administrative buildings. The bombs followed a relatively quiet period on the island in recent weeks amid a pledged government crackdown.
